notes.purpose: Hay bales on posts and a hay stack inside a fenced cobble pen read as much as an animal pen as a drill yard; nothing says archery or weapons yet.
notes.detail: Torches on the corner posts, a bench and two storage blocks; the floor is a busy gravel/coarse-dirt patchwork.
notes.roof: A yard, no roof: judged on the post tops (torches on logs).
notes.life: Moss on the curb, torches; no plants.

visual.summary: Fenced, raised gravel drill yard with spruce corner posts, two hay-bale dummies, hay butts at the back and a bench and store by the entrance.
problems: Does not read as a training yard yet: give at least one dummy fence arms (x=1/x=3 at y=2 beside the dummy at x=2, z=3) or put a weapon rack/chest marker by the entrance so L1 says 'military', not 'pen'.
Floor patchwork of coarse dirt (y=0) is noisy; group it into a worn path along the dummies and the archery lane instead of scattered patches.
Reach: whole yard floor reached; only the post tops and hay dummy top are unreached (fine).

notes.detail: Round-1 problems fixed (dummies with fence arms, weapon rack of barrels with a spear rail, one solid sparring floor, no scattered dirt), but the gravel archery lane and the stone brick path are wide and empty; only torches on the posts and two dummies.
notes.purpose: Now reads as a drill yard rather than an animal pen thanks to the armed dummies and the row of hay butts, but without targets the right half is just a gravel strip.
notes.roof: Open yard, no roof: neutral score.
notes.life: Mossy cobblestone in the curb and torches; no plants yet (flowers come at L3).

visual.summary: Fenced 11 x 11 drill yard on a cobblestone curb: a stone brick drill path, a coarse-dirt sparring ground with two hay dummies with fence arms and a weapon rack, and a gravel archery lane ending in a row of hay butts.
problems: The archery lane (x=6..9, z=2..9) is a bare gravel strip at L1: a shooting-line edge of stone brick slabs or a pair of fence-post lane markers at z=3 would make it read as a lane before the L2 targets arrive.
Reach: the whole yard floor is reached; only post tops and dummy tops are unreached (fine).
